budgetSimulator.title: Build your Zero-Based Budget
budgetSimulator.description: Drag funds (tokens) from the Treasury into sectors. Each token represents 5% of GDP.
budgetSimulator.dragTokens: Drag these tokens to the sectors to allocate the budget.

gov-efficiency.title: Government Efficiency
gov-efficiency.overview: Drastic reduction of current expenditure, consolidation of 24 to 8 ministries, and total digitalization of public services via AI.

education.title: Education
education.overview: Transformation of the educational model towards STEM, critical thinking, and bilingualism, with personalized AI tutors for every student.

security.title: Citizen Security
security.overview: Police reform focusing on predictive prevention, use of body cameras, and facial recognition technology.

health.title: Public Health
health.overview: Integrated health system with a preventive focus, universal blockchain medical records, and 24/7 telemedicine.

economy.title: Economy & Taxation
economy.overview: Tax simplification, elimination of inefficient exemptions, and fostering formality and entrepreneurship.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure & Transport
infrastructure.overview: Modernization of mass public transport, development of intercity trains, and sustainable mobility systems.

justice.title: Justice & Transparency
justice.overview: Total independence of the judicial branch, digitalization of records, and severe penalties and disqualification for corruption.

environment.title: Environment
environment.overview: Strict protection of water resources, accelerated energy transition, and advanced solid waste management.

energy.title: Energy
energy.overview: Elimination of inefficient subsidies, aggressive transition to renewables, and modernization of the distribution grid.

tourism.title: Tourism
tourism.overview: Diversification of the model towards medical tourism, digital nomads, and sustainability, reducing dependence on 'all-inclusive'.

agriculture.title: Agriculture
agriculture.overview: Technification of the countryside, robotic greenhouses, and artificial intelligence for food sovereignty.

housing.title: Housing
housing.overview: Eradication of the housing deficit through 3D prefabricated social housing and accessible financing plans.

culture.title: Culture
culture.overview: Digitalization of heritage, immersive VR museums, and fostering the orange economy.

foreign-trade.title: Foreign Trade
foreign-trade.overview: Total automation of ports (Zero-Touch Ports) and positioning as the Caribbean Logistics Hub.

labor.title: Labor Sector
labor.overview: Labor code reform for greater flexibility, telework, and linking subsidies to technological retraining.

water.title: Water Resources
water.overview: Desalination plants, public-private partnerships for distribution, and tiered smart pricing.

pension.title: Pension System (AFP)
pension.overview: Parametric reform, investment in international index funds (S&P 500), and early retirement options.

migration.title: Migration
migration.overview: Smart border with drone swarms, digitalization of visas, and strict enforcement of the labor law (80/20).
